ण: ण 1. ण, the nasal ण् belonging to the third or cerebral class of consonants. —ण-कार, अस्, m. the letter or sound ण्।

ण 2. ण, अस्, m. knowledge; certainty, ascertainment; ornament; a water or summer-house; a bad man; a N. of Vindu-deva, said to be a Jaina deity; an epithet of Śiva; the sound of negation; gift, giving.
णद्: णद् णद्, णम्, णश्, &c. Many roots which really begin with the dental न् are written in native grammars and the Dhātu-pāṭha with the cerebral ण् to show that the nasal is liable to be cerebralized when preceded by prepositions like प्र, परि, &c. These roots will be found in the present Dictionary under the dental न्। See नद्, नम्, नश्, &c.
ण्य: ण्य ण्य, अस्, m., N. of an ocean in Brahma-loka.
